title: Ukrainian Beef Fillet Stew
description: A rich and savory stew featuring beef fillet, perfect for a solo dinner, with a winey and gooey texture, dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef fillet cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine to the pot and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
